simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to הַמְנִיךְ (H2002) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: הַמְנִיךְ (hamnîyk) means a necklace First listed occurrence: Dan 5 7.

definitions.full: H2002. hamnika הַמְנִיכָא Qr (Kt המינכָא , also [Gi] המוניכא , etc.) noun [masculine] chain, necklace (Talmud הַמְנִכָּא D WB 108 ; Syriac ; loan-word from Greek μανιάκης K § 64, 4 ; or < Persian hämy¹n , girdle [diminutive would be hamy¹nak ] (whence also Greek μαν ., Bev Dr Dan 5:7 ) Andr M 60* (reading הַמְיָֽנְכָא ); see also Behrm ix Lag Ges. Abh. 40; Arm. Stud. 1420 ; see Krauss 5f. (who compares also Talmud מָנְיָיק מוּנְיָיק, necklace, bracelet , Levy NHWB iii. 52 b, 158 b D 230 )); — of gold, 5:7 , 16 , 29 .
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) but the text is הֲמוּנֵךְ ; of foreign origin;
